text:
riley: opening thread — Nimbus presales: expected promo spikes up to 900 rps for ~12min, baseline ~320 rps. they want firm guidance on reserved vs burst + safe autoscale settings.

sasha: quick Qs: avg token length? chat vs embeddings mix? strict latency SLOs?

riley: they gave avg ~150 tokens, 80% chat, 20% embeddings. target p95 < 1s, p50 ~150-200ms. leaning toward 13B quant for cost.

mohit: throughput calc: 900 * 150 = 135k tokens/s. naive per-GPU token rates are misleading without caching/batching. propose reserved for steady 300-350 rps and burst credits to cover spikes.

tess: my read — reserved pool sized for baseline (320 rps) + buffer for promo ramp (reserve 6 GPUs). burst credits to cover additional ~600 rps for 15min windows. add autoscale min_replicas to avoid cold starts.

infra-bot: Autoscale suggestion: ```json
{"min_replicas":"4","max_replicas":"16","metric":"rps","target_rps_per_replica":"75","ramp_window_s":"30"}
```

mohit: routing: default -> quant13, fallback -> fp1670 for tail loads. trigger fallback when queue_depth > 80 or p95 > 900ms for 60s.

sasha: pricing ask from Nimbus: how much cheaper is a 12mo reserved commit vs pure burst? also want credit bucket sizing guidance.

riley: i'll ping finance, but ballpark reserved reduces unit cost ~20% vs pure on-demand for quant setups. need exact SKU calc.

security-bot: flagged item: Nimbus requires customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and monthly audit export.

mohit: we support customer KMS on Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports envelope encryption + audit exports; for full VPC peering and HSM keys recommend Private deployment. note in proposal.

tess: operational runbook bullets: - KV preheat 8-12m before promo (synth hits to prefix) - burst window cap (max continuous 20m) - edge rate limiter (HTTP 429 + Retry-After) - canary model rollouts.

sasha: include sample preheat command and client retry guidance. preheat example:```bash
for i in $(seq 1 600); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/preheat -d '{"prefix":"nimbus-camp","hits":1}' & done
```

mohit: monitoring thresholds to include: p95 latency > 1s, queue_depth > 100, replica_error_rate > 1% -> trigger fallback + paging.

riley: client asked about queueing behavior if autoscale lags — recommend edge throttling and cached fallback payloads for non-critical calls; return thin error + Retry-After rather than blocking.

infra-bot: created doc /ops/poc/nimbus/surge-plan-v1 for review in #eng-ops.

sasha: can we offer a blended option: reserve 4 GPUs steady, plus a dedicated burst pool (reserved credits) that can be converted into short-lived capacity during promos? that reduces overcommit risk.

mohit: yes, suggest reserve 4 GPUs + convertable burst credits sized for +500 rps for 15min windows. autoscale min 4 / max 16, with fast ramp and KV warmup.

security-bot: add to proposal: sample audit log export (S3 path), KMS key-policy example, and SOC2 compliance note.

riley: action items: 1) finance quote for 12mo reserve + burst credits (i'll loop them) 2) ops to draft POC runbook (preheat, sim load, failover test) 3) security to prep KMS + audit appendix.

tess: scheduling: propose 30-min preflight POC with Nimbus ops tomorrow morning. riley to confirm. :calendar:

riley: will confirm time and assemble proposal: reserve 4 GPUs steady, burst credits for +500 rps (15m windows), autoscale min4/max16, KV preheat, fallback routing, security appendix. sending draft EOD. :thumbsup:
